author: Walt Disney Imagineering YouTube
text:
With great power there must also come... push-pull testing 🕷️
Before guests ever board, Imagineers perform push-pull testing at Shanghai Disneyland's brand-new Spider-Man-themed land, slowly moving a ride vehicle through the attraction at just one centimeter per second. It may be one of the slowest parts of the project, but every centimeter brings us one step closer to the next milestone.
